title: Please Go Home, Miss Akutsu!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: High schooler Kouta Oyama lives alone, until delinquent classmate Riko Akutsu starts treating his apartment as her after-school hangout to read manga, play games and eat snacks, sometimes staying the night. She teases him constantly while slowly falling for him, and later her parents turn out to have had the same story.
life_message: It holds up an easygoing, low-stakes everyday routine and the comfort of a familiar place to hang out.
